architecture_findings: The audit job is a single sequential production chain; its Python steps are not independently dispatchable merely because they have registry entries.
The publish job is a separate privileged boundary with contents:write and must remain a gated workflow-level operation.
Failure cursor recovery is retained as a run-scoped immutable Actions artifact; it does not write repository files.
The compile/test step references many scripts for validation only; those references must not be interpreted as execution edges.
Workflow-native shell, artifact, GitHub API and GitHub issue actions remain orchestration capabilities and need explicit contracts before decomposition.
Source assessment is dispatched by automation-watchdog only after the exact production discovery workflow completes successfully on main; it is not an independent direct-dispatch path.
The failed-run cursor recovery job inherits the workflow-level shadowrocket-main-writer lock; it does not write repository files.

A dedicated Watchdog source-discovery workflow and immutable run-bound artifact handoff are implemented on the integration branch. Its adapter/orchestration and Assessment adapter remain disabled; the monolithic auto_sync discovery/assessment fallback is retained to prevent a gap or duplicate execution.
decomposition_constraints: Preserve the audit -> publish dependency and the existing single-writer concurrency boundary.
A capability can run alone only after its input snapshot, output artifacts, dependencies, resource leases, timeout/retry, idempotency and independent verifier are implemented.
The publish job must not be decomposed into independently writable capability jobs without a single controlled publisher.
The review cursor recovery job runs only after audit failure and must remain a recovery path.
Dashboard generation is observer-only and is not a production stage.

review_context.note: Refreshed against the integration branch's current workflow, registry, release manifest and adapter blobs. Independent Python dispatch remains disabled; the source-discovery workflow is implemented but dormant. Static inventory evidence is not execution authorization.

duplicate_protection.rule: auto_sync direct discovery and assessment steps remain the fallback while the independent workflow and assessment adapters are disabled; remove the monolithic steps only after the independent edge is authorized and accepted
